findings.description: The bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, so objects stored in it (including the vendor roster spreadsheet) are not encrypted at rest by default.
This bucket stores financial ledger export data but has no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving sensitive financial records unencrypted at rest.
Despite having versioning and logging configured, no server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so model artifacts are stored unencrypted.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is set for this bucket, leaving operational runbook content (which may include sensitive operational/security details) unencrypted at rest.
The object is uploaded to reports_archive, a bucket without default encryption, and does not specify its own server_side_encryption or kms_key_id, so this file is stored unencrypted at rest.
